panels.title: Сессии (24ч)
panels.description: Уникальные голосовые сессии (scenario.started) за сутки.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT request_id) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='scenario.started' AND received_at > now() - interval '24 hours';

panels.title: Уникальные пользователи (24ч)
panels.description: Distinct Telegram user_id за сутки. Web-сессии без Telegram не считаются.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT payload->'scenario'->>'user_id') AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND received_at > now() - interval '24 hours' AND payload->'scenario'->>'user_id' IS NOT NULL;
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='voice.search.launched' AND received_at > now() - interval '24 hours';

panels.title: Переспросов (24ч)
panels.description: voice.slot.reask — сколько раз ассистент не понял ответ и переспросил.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='voice.slot.reask' AND received_at > now() - interval '24 hours';
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND received_at > now() - interval '24 hours' AND (status='error' OR type LIKE '%.failed');

SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (payload->'scenario'->>'latency_ms')::numeric) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='voice.transcribe.completed' AND received_at > now() - interval '24 hours' AND payload->'scenario'->>'latency_ms' IS NOT NULL;

panels.title: Воронка голосового запроса
panels.description: Старт сессии → распознан голос → указал «Куда» → запустил поиск → нашлись билеты. По request_id.

targets.rawSql: WITH ew AS (SELECT * FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND $__timeFilter(received_at)) SELECT step AS metric, n AS value FROM (VALUES ('1. Старт сессии', (SELECT count(DISTINCT request_id) FROM ew WHERE type='scenario.started')), ('2. Распознан голос', (SELECT count(DISTINCT request_id) FROM ew WHERE type='voice.transcribe.completed')), ('3. Указал «Куда»', (SELECT count(DISTINCT request_id) FROM ew WHERE type='voice.slot.filled' AND payload->'scenario'->>'slot'='destination')), ('4. Запустил поиск', (SELECT count(DISTINCT request_id) FROM ew WHERE type='voice.search.launched')), ('5. Нашлись билеты', (SELECT count(DISTINCT request_id) FROM ew WHERE type='voice.search.completed' AND status='success'))) AS t(step, n);

panels.title: Переспросы по причине
panels.description: Почему ассистент переспрашивал: city / date / adults / silence / all / unparsed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(payload->'scenario'->>'reason','—') AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='voice.slot.reask' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

panels.title: Переспросы по слоту
panels.description: Какой параметр чаще не понимали: destination / origin / date / adults.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(payload->'scenario'->>'slot','—') AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='voice.slot.reask' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;
SELECT date_trunc('minute', received_at) AS time, type AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT COALESCE(payload->'scenario'->>'slot','—') AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='voice.slot.filled' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT date_trunc('minute', received_at) AS time, 'transcribe p95' AS metric, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (payload->'scenario'->>'latency_ms')::numeric) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='voice.transcribe.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND payload->'scenario'->>'latency_ms' IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('minute', received_at), 'search p95', percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (payload->'scenario'->>'latency_ms')::numeric) FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='voice.search.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND payload->'scenario'->>'latency_ms' IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Сессии (последние)
panels.description: По request_id: когда, кто, сколько переспросов/голосовых реплик, дошёл ли до поиска, сколько билетов нашлось.

targets.rawSql: WITH ew AS (SELECT * FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND $__timeFilter(received_at)) SELECT min(received_at) AS started, max(payload->'scenario'->>'user_id') AS usr, request_id AS session, count(*) FILTER (WHERE type='voice.transcribe.completed') AS voice_turns, count(*) FILTER (WHERE type='voice.slot.reask') AS reasks, bool_or(type='voice.search.launched') AS searched, max((payload->'scenario'->>'count')::int) FILTER (WHERE type='voice.search.completed') AS tickets FROM ew WHERE request_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY request_id ORDER BY started DESC LIMIT 60;

panels.title: Разбор фразы — что сказал / что собрали / где не хватило
panels.description: voice.parse.completed: исходная фраза, распознанные origin/dest/date, готовность к поиску и что просили уточнить.

targets.rawSql: SELECT received_at AS time, payload->'scenario'->>'user_id' AS usr, data AS heard, COALESCE(payload->'scenario'->>'origin_name', payload->'scenario'->>'origin') AS origin, COALESCE(payload->'scenario'->>'destination_name', payload->'scenario'->>'destination') AS dest, payload->'scenario'->>'date' AS dt, payload->'scenario'->>'ready' AS ready, payload->'scenario'->>'clarify' AS clarify FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='voice.parse.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 60;

SELECT received_at AS time, payload->'scenario'->>'user_id' AS usr, payload->'scenario'->>'slot' AS slot, payload->'scenario'->>'reason' AS reason, payload->'scenario'->>'attempt' AS attempt, payload->'scenario'->>'kind' AS kind FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='voice.slot.reask' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 80;

SELECT received_at AS time, type, status, data AS detail, payload->'scenario'->>'user_id' AS usr FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND (status='error' OR type LIKE '%.failed') AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 80;

panels.title: Покупки (24ч)
panels.description: Клики «Купить» (feed.buy) → переход на гейт.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='feed.buy' AND received_at > now() - interval '24 hours';
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='feed.ticket.open' AND received_at > now() - interval '24 hours';
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='feed.tab' AND received_at > now() - interval '24 hours';
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='feed.filter' AND payload->'scenario'->>'on'='true' AND received_at > now() - interval '24 hours';

panels.title: Клики по табам (Обзор / График / Все билеты)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(payload->'scenario'->>'label', payload->'scenario'->>'tab') AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='feed.tab' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

panels.title: Фильтры по категории
panels.description: Какие фильтры включают: пересадки / время / цена / длительность / багаж / авиакомпания.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(payload->'scenario'->>'cat','—') AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='feed.filter' AND payload->'scenario'->>'on'='true' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT COALESCE(payload->'scenario'->>'label', payload->'scenario'->>'sort') AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='feed.sort' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

panels.title: Результаты поиска — всего билетов и по 3 группам
panels.description: feed.results.shown: общее число рейсов, оптимальная выборка, всего уникальных, и сколько показано в каждой из 3 групп Обзора (дешёвые/оптимальные/быстрые) + партиция rec-engine.

targets.rawSql: SELECT received_at AS time, payload->'scenario'->>'user_id' AS usr, payload->'scenario'->>'origin' AS origin, payload->'scenario'->>'destination' AS dest, (payload->'scenario'->>'total')::int AS total, (payload->'scenario'->>'selection')::int AS selection, (payload->'scenario'->>'all_offers')::int AS all_offers, (payload->'scenario'->'groups_shown'->>'cheapest')::int AS g_cheap, (payload->'scenario'->'groups_shown'->>'optimal')::int AS g_optimal, (payload->'scenario'->'groups_shown'->>'fastest')::int AS g_fast, payload->'scenario'->>'selection_groups' AS rec_groups FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='feed.results.shown' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 60;

panels.title: Расходы на модели (24ч)
panels.description: Сумма cost_rub по всем вызовам моделей (LLM реальная цена polza + оценка STT/TTS).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum((payload->'scenario'->>'cost_rub')::numeric),0) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type IN ('llm.inference.completed','model.stt.completed','model.tts.completed','model.convai.completed') AND received_at > now() - interval '24 hours';

SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type IN ('llm.inference.completed','model.stt.completed','model.tts.completed','model.convai.completed') AND received_at > now() - interval '24 hours';

SELECT COALESCE(sum((payload->'llm_tokens'->>'total_tokens')::numeric),0) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='llm.inference.completed' AND received_at > now() - interval '24 hours';

panels.title: Сред. стоимость сессии (24ч)
panels.description: Сумма cost_rub / число уникальных сессий (request_id) за 24ч.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(COALESCE(sum((payload->'scenario'->>'cost_rub')::numeric),0) / NULLIF(count(DISTINCT request_id),0), 4) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type IN ('llm.inference.completed','model.stt.completed','model.tts.completed','model.convai.completed') AND received_at > now() - interval '24 hours' AND request_id IS NOT NULL;

panels.title: Стоимость по шагам (₽)
panels.description: На какой шаг сколько тратится: parse / assistant / analyze.insights / advice / smart-advice / transcribe / tts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(payload->'scenario'->>'step','—') AS metric, round(sum((payload->'scenario'->>'cost_rub')::numeric),4) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type IN ('llm.inference.completed','model.stt.completed','model.tts.completed','model.convai.completed') AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT COALESCE(payload->'scenario'->>'model','—') AS metric, round(sum((payload->'scenario'->>'cost_rub')::numeric),4) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type IN ('llm.inference.completed','model.stt.completed','model.tts.completed','model.convai.completed') AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT COALESCE(payload->'scenario'->>'model','—') AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type IN ('llm.inference.completed','model.stt.completed','model.tts.completed','model.convai.completed') AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT date_trunc('minute', received_at) AS time, COALESCE(payload->'scenario'->>'step','—') AS metric, sum((payload->'scenario'->>'cost_rub')::numeric) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type IN ('llm.inference.completed','model.stt.completed','model.tts.completed','model.convai.completed') AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Стоимость по сессиям (₽) — смета на пользователя
panels.description: По request_id: суммарная стоимость, число вызовов моделей, токены и какие шаги были.

targets.rawSql: SELECT request_id AS session, max(payload->'scenario'->>'user_id') AS usr, round(sum((payload->'scenario'->>'cost_rub')::numeric),4) AS cost_rub, count(*) AS calls, COALESCE(sum((payload->'llm_tokens'->>'total_tokens')::numeric),0) AS tokens, string_agg(DISTINCT payload->'scenario'->>'step', ', ') AS steps FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type IN ('llm.inference.completed','model.stt.completed','model.tts.completed','model.convai.completed') AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND request_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY request_id ORDER BY cost_rub DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 60;

panels.title: Последние вызовы моделей
panels.description: Каждый вызов: шаг, тип (text/stt/tts), модель, провайдер, токены, стоимость (est=оценка для аудио).

targets.rawSql: SELECT received_at AS time, request_id AS session, payload->'scenario'->>'step' AS step, payload->'scenario'->>'kind' AS kind, payload->'scenario'->>'model' AS model, payload->'scenario'->>'provider' AS provider, payload->'llm_tokens'->>'total_tokens' AS tokens, payload->'scenario'->>'credits' AS credits, round((payload->'scenario'->>'cost_rub')::numeric,5) AS cost_rub, payload->'scenario'->>'cost_estimated' AS est FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type IN ('llm.inference.completed','model.stt.completed','model.tts.completed','model.convai.completed') AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 80;

panels.title: Источник: поиски
panels.description: Поиски по источнику: telegram/web (живые) vs скрипт (platform=unknown).

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN payload->'scenario'->>'platform'='unknown' THEN 'скрипт' WHEN payload->'scenario'->>'platform'='web' THEN 'web' WHEN payload->'scenario'->>'platform' IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE 'telegram' END AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='voice.search.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT CASE WHEN payload->'scenario'->>'platform'='unknown' THEN 'скрипт' WHEN payload->'scenario'->>'platform'='web' THEN 'web' WHEN payload->'scenario'->>'platform' IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE 'telegram' END AS metric, round(sum((payload->'scenario'->>'cost_rub')::numeric),3) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type IN ('llm.inference.completed','model.stt.completed','model.tts.completed','model.convai.completed') AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

panels.title: Источник: сводка
panels.description: По источнику: сессии, поиски, уник. юзеры, стоимость ₽.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN payload->'scenario'->>'platform'='unknown' THEN 'скрипт' WHEN payload->'scenario'->>'platform'='web' THEN 'web' WHEN payload->'scenario'->>'platform' IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE 'telegram' END AS source, count(DISTINCT request_id) AS sessions, count(*) FILTER (WHERE type='voice.search.completed') AS searches, count(DISTINCT payload->'scenario'->>'user_id') AS users, round(sum((payload->'scenario'->>'cost_rub')::numeric),3) AS cost_rub FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY searches DESC;

SELECT date_trunc('minute', received_at) AS time, CASE WHEN payload->'scenario'->>'platform'='unknown' THEN 'скрипт' WHEN payload->'scenario'->>'platform'='web' THEN 'web' WHEN payload->'scenario'->>'platform' IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE 'telegram' END AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='voice.search.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Разговоров с агентом (24ч)
panels.description: ElevenLabs Conversational AI — начатые разговоры.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='agent.connected' AND received_at > now() - interval '24 hours';

SELECT round(avg((payload->'scenario'->>'duration_secs')::numeric),0) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='model.convai.completed' AND received_at > now() - interval '24 hours' AND payload->'scenario'->>'duration_secs' IS NOT NULL;

panels.title: Стоимость агента (24ч)
panels.description: Точная стоимость разговоров (metadata.cost ElevenLabs → ₽). Дорого: ~16₽ за разговор.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(round(sum((payload->'scenario'->>'cost_rub')::numeric),2),0) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='model.convai.completed' AND received_at > now() - interval '24 hours';

SELECT round(avg((payload->'scenario'->>'message_count')::numeric),1) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='model.convai.completed' AND received_at > now() - interval '24 hours' AND payload->'scenario'->>'message_count' IS NOT NULL;

panels.title: Агент: воронка
panels.description: Подключился → назвал параметр → submit_search → нашлись билеты (по request_id).

targets.rawSql: WITH ew AS (SELECT * FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND $__timeFilter(received_at)) SELECT step AS metric, n AS value FROM (VALUES ('1. подключился',(SELECT count(DISTINCT request_id) FROM ew WHERE type='agent.connected')),('2. назвал параметр',(SELECT count(DISTINCT request_id) FROM ew WHERE type='agent.params.updated')),('3. submit_search',(SELECT count(DISTINCT request_id) FROM ew WHERE type='agent.search.submitted')),('4. нашлись билеты',(SELECT count(DISTINCT request_id) FROM ew WHERE type='voice.search.completed' AND status='success'))) AS t(step,n);

SELECT received_at AS time, payload->'scenario'->>'user_id' AS usr, payload->'scenario'->>'conversation_id' AS conversation, (payload->'scenario'->>'duration_secs')::int AS dur_s, (payload->'scenario'->>'message_count')::int AS msgs, payload->'scenario'->>'credits' AS credits, round((payload->'scenario'->>'cost_rub')::numeric,2) AS cost_rub FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='model.convai.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 50;

panels.title: Агент: транскрипт (последние реплики)
panels.description: agent.message — что говорил пользователь (user) и агент (agent).

targets.rawSql: SELECT received_at AS time, payload->'scenario'->>'user_id' AS usr, left(request_id,8) AS sess, payload->'scenario'->>'role' AS role, data AS text FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='agent.message' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 80;

panels.title: Opus: сообщений (24ч)
panels.description: Сообщения пользователя в Opus-чате.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='opus.message' AND received_at > now() - interval '24 hours';
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='opus.search' AND received_at > now() - interval '24 hours';
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='opus.filter.applied' AND received_at > now() - interval '24 hours';
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='opus.reply' AND received_at > now() - interval '24 hours';

panels.title: Opus: ответы по типу
panels.description: results (поиск) / compare (сравнение) / text (ответ из памяти/не понял).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(payload->'scenario'->>'kind','—') AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='opus.reply' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

panels.title: Opus: фильтры по источнику
panels.description: sovet (тап подсказки) / chip (чип-фильтр) / removed (снят фильтр).

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN type='opus.filter.removed' THEN 'removed' ELSE COALESCE(payload->'scenario'->>'source','filter') END AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type IN ('opus.filter.applied','opus.filter.removed') AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

panels.title: Opus: транскрипт чата (последнее)
panels.description: opus.message (что спросил юзер) + opus.reply (что ответил Opus: kind + текст).

targets.rawSql: SELECT received_at AS time, payload->'scenario'->>'user_id' AS usr, left(request_id,8) AS sess, CASE WHEN type='opus.message' THEN 'user' ELSE 'opus:'||COALESCE(payload->'scenario'->>'kind','') END AS role, data AS text FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type IN ('opus.message','opus.reply') AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 100;

panels.title: Записи звука (последние) — клик «слушать»
panels.description: Аудио, что шло в помощника: /transcribe (Opus/голос) + разговоры агента ElevenLabs. Колонка audio — ссылка на плеер /api/audio/{id}.

targets.rawSql: SELECT received_at AS time, payload->'scenario'->>'user_id' AS usr, 'запись' AS kind, left(COALESCE(data,''),50) AS text, payload->'scenario'->>'audio_url' AS audio FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type IN ('voice.transcribe.completed','voice.transcribe.empty','voice.transcribe.failed') AND payload->'scenario'->>'audio_url' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at) UNION ALL SELECT received_at, payload->'scenario'->>'user_id', 'агент-разговор', 'conv '||COALESCE(payload->'scenario'->>'duration_secs','')||'с', payload->'scenario'->>'audio_url' FROM events WHERE service='avia_platform' AND type='model.convai.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'audio_url' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 80;
